Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 13
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error by incorrectly identifying the director of "A Couch in New York" as Sophie Barthes. In Step 13, the Planner's "Updated Understanding" explicitly states: "A Couch in New York (2005) -- director Sophie Barthes (birth year to confirm)". This is incorrect; the film "A Couch in New York" (released in 1996) was directed by Chantal Akerman. This error was likely caused by the Planner misinterpreting the WebSurfer results from Step 12, where the search for "A Couch in New York director" clearly returned Chantal Akerman, but the Planner failed to update its internal state correctly and instead hallucinated a different director (Sophie Barthes) and an incorrect release year (2005). This led to a flawed comparison of directors' ages, as the entire premise of the comparison was based on the wrong director and wrong film details.
